# Demo: Hybrid Local/Remote Routing

End-to-end hybrid workflow: Profile application, Gateway Reconciliation, bare start of the LOCAL slice, UNIX separation (DRIFTED before reconcile), live Route switch without restarting callers, fail-fast 5xx when a LOCAL target stops, and secret redaction.

## Step 1: Clean estate before applying a Profile or starting the Gateway

```console
$ procomp status
Project: procomp-e2e
SERVICE        ROUTE   OWNER  HEALTH   BUILD       GIT      PORT   PID  UPTIME  RSS  STALE
broker         REMOTE  NONE   STOPPED  NO_BUILDER  NO_REPO  16161  -    -       -    no
orders         REMOTE  NONE   STOPPED  NO_BUILDER  NO_REPO  18101  -    -       -    no
pricing        REMOTE  NONE   STOPPED  NO_BUILDER  NO_REPO  18102  -    -       -    no
notifications  REMOTE  NONE   STOPPED  NO_BUILDER  NO_REPO  18103  -    -       -    no
Gateway: port 18080, NONE, STOPPED, OFFLINE
```

## Step 2: Apply the orders-local Profile, start the WireMock Gateway, and reconcile mappings

```console
$ procomp profile use orders-local
Applied profile 'orders-local' (3 LOCAL, 1 REMOTE)

$ procomp gateway start
Gateway: spawned MANAGED (procomp) [PID 10000, HEALTHY] -> http://127.0.0.1:18080

$ procomp gateway reconcile
Gateway: reconciled 4 route mapping(s) on http://127.0.0.1:18080 (IN_SYNC)

$ procomp gateway status
Gateway:         wiremock (http://127.0.0.1:18080)
Port:            18080
Owner:           MANAGED (procomp)
Health:          HEALTHY
PID:             10000
Uptime:          5s
Sync Status:     IN_SYNC
```
